definition_common: 有弹性的;能迅速恢复的
example1_en: Children are often more resilient than adults think.
example1_cn: 孩子们通常比大人认为的更有恢复力.
example2_en: The resilient economy bounced back quickly.
example2_cn: 有弹性的经济迅速反弹.
mnemonic: 联想:像弹簧一样能弹回→有弹性的

example1_en: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
example1_cn: 智能手机在现代生活中无处不在.
example2_en: The ubiquitous presence of social media affects everyone.
example2_cn: 社交媒体无处不在的影响着每个人.
mnemonic: 联想:ubi(哪里)+quit(离开)→哪里都离不开→无处不在的
